clauses.mechanism: express revocation of EO 9074 performed by this order itself on December 28, 1945 (no effective-date wording; self-executing command spent on performance)
clauses.reason: The sole clause orders Executive Order 9074 revoked; the operative words are "hereby revoked." The Federal Register text of the order prints the signature date "December 28, 1945" and the filing line "Filed, Dec. 29, 1945;". The command to revoke was performed, and so exhausted, on 1945-12-28. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of the order itself. No later instrument, amendment, extension or earlier event alters or ends the command: the dossier chain is empty and the order states no until-date, report date or condition.

research_rationale:
EO 9667 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9667.txt, 11 FR 4, PDF page 4); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order's one operative sentence revokes Executive Order 9074 of February 25, 1942. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The Federal Register text prints the signature date "December 28, 1945" and the filing line "Filed, Dec. 29, 1945;". The sentence ending "hereby revoked." has no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, December 28, 1945. Under owner ruling 2026-10-28 (evidence decides) a command that was performed on its date is recorded as exhausted by performance on that date.

savings.reason: The order contains no savings, transfer or residual clause; it only revokes Executive Order 9074. The machine searches of the U.S. Code and the eCFR (both as of the October 14, 2026 cutoff, edition caveats stated in their coverage notes) and the Federal Register catalog return no hit citing EO 9667, so no held source continues any command of this order.
